$comment: The complete, sorted list of RUNTIME value exports of the public barrel (src/index.ts). Type-only exports are erased and do not appear. Two consumers assert EXACT equality against it: src/tests/unit/api/barrel-side-effects.test.ts (the source barrel, under vitest) and scripts/check-lib-exports.mjs (the built dist/lib bundle, under `pnpm build:lib:check`). Adding or removing a public value export means editing this file in the same change; a leak or a lost export then fails in both places. Keep the list sorted (the test checks) so a diff reads as one line per change.
